segments.text: Red light. You're waiting at the crossing. Then the manhole covers start to float.
Above the crossing hangs a giant magnet. And somebody just switched it on. What do you do?
Most drivers think: floor it. Get out from under there, fast.
Big mistake. You hit the open manhole. Your car jumps. And the magnet catches you, mid-air.
Then every other car comes flying up too. The crane swings round, and drops you all into the crusher. Crunch. Your car is now a cube.
Here's how you do it properly.
Stop. Engine off. And open the glovebox.
Grandma's fridge magnet. Put it on the roof. The wrong way round.
North against north. Magnets hate that. The big one gets pushed away, swings back, and sticks to its own crane. Clang!
And everything it grabbed comes back down. Right where it belongs.
Green light. And you drive on, with the strongest fridge magnet in town.
Next exam question: the road ahead rolls up like a carpet. Follow, so you don't miss it.
